skill.summary: Latvia customs declarations analytics — 3.8GB, KN8 codes, trends, seasonal patterns, top declarants

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of customs-analytics skill:

- Provides analytics on Latvia customs declarations (3.8GB dataset)
- Supports queries by KN8 product codes for trends and seasonal patterns
- Offers endpoints to identify top declarants and analyze import/export data
- Includes guidance on usage for trade analysis and monitoring
- Public documentation and API base URL provided
